tools.name: read_file
tools.snippet: Read the full text of one file at a workspace path.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to read.

encoding.description: Text encoding used to decode the bytes.

maxBytes.description: Stop after this many bytes and report truncation.

tools.name: write_file
tools.snippet: Create or overwrite a file at a workspace path with the given text.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to write.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file instead of failing.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.snippet: List the entries of a directory, optionally recursively.

tools.name: search_files
tools.snippet: Find files whose contents match a text or regular-expression pattern.

pattern.description: Literal text or regular expression to look for inside files.

maxResults.description: Stop after this many matching lines.

tools.name: move_file
tools.snippet: Move or rename a file or directory to a new workspace path.

to.description: Destination workspace-relative path, including the new name.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination instead of failing.

tools.name: create_event
tools.snippet: Add a calendar event with a title, start and end time, and optional attendees.

title.description: Event title shown on the calendar.

start.description: Start time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end.description: End time as an ISO 8601 timestamp; must be after start.

location.description: Room name, address, or meeting link.

description.description: Agenda or notes shown in the invitation.

tools.name: list_events
tools.snippet: List calendar events between two times.

calendarId.description: Calendar to read; defaults to the user's primary calendar.

tools.name: reschedule_event
tools.snippet: Change the start and end time of an existing calendar event.

eventId.description: Identifier of the event to move.

start.description: New start time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

end.description: New end time; omit to keep the original duration.

tools.name: cancel_event
tools.snippet: Delete a calendar event and optionally notify its attendees.

eventId.description: Identifier of the event to cancel.

reason.description: Optional message included in the cancellation notice.

tools.name: find_free_slot
tools.snippet: Find open time slots of a given length within a date range across attendees' calendars.

durationMinutes.description: Length of the slot to find.

attendees.description: People whose calendars must all be free.

tools.name: send_email
tools.snippet: Send an email with a subject, body, and optional attachments to recipients.

attachments.description: Workspace paths of files to attach.

tools.name: search_inbox
tools.snippet: Search received email messages by sender, subject, text, or date range.

query.description: Words to match in subject or body.

from.description: Restrict to messages from this sender address or name.

after.description: Only messages received on or after this date.

before.description: Only messages received before this date.

tools.name: draft_reply
tools.snippet: Create an unsent reply draft to an existing email thread.

threadId.description: Identifier of the thread being answered.

replyAll.description: Address every participant instead of only the last sender.

tools.name: archive_thread
tools.snippet: Remove an email thread from the inbox without deleting it.

threadId.description: Identifier of the thread to archive.

markRead.description: Also mark every message in the thread as read.

tools.name: add_label
tools.snippet: Apply a named label or folder to an email thread.

threadId.description: Identifier of the thread to label.

label.description: Label name; created if it does not exist.

removeFromInbox.description: Also archive the thread after labelling.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.snippet: Download a web page and return its readable text content.

url.description: Absolute http or https URL to fetch.

maxChars.description: Truncate extracted text at this length.

includeLinks.description: Append the list of hyperlinks found on the page.

tools.name: web_search
tools.snippet: Search the public web and return result titles, links, and snippets.

recencyDays.description: Only results published within this many days.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.snippet: List every hyperlink on a web page, with anchor text.

url.description: Page whose links should be listed.

sameDomainOnly.description: Drop links pointing to other domains.

tools.name: screenshot_page
tools.snippet: Render a web page in a headless browser and return a screenshot image.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport.

tools.name: check_link_status
tools.snippet: Report the HTTP status of one or more URLs without downloading their bodies.

urls.description: Links to probe with HEAD requests.

followRedirects.description: Report the final status after redirects.

tools.name: query_sql
tools.snippet: Run a read-only SQL query against a named database and return rows.

database.description: Connection name from the configured list.

sql.description: A single SELECT statement; writes are rejected.

maxRows.description: Row limit applied to the result.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.snippet: Show the columns, types, and keys of a database table.

database.description: Connection name from the configured list.

includeIndexes.description: Also list indexes and their columns.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.snippet: Write the rows of a table or query result to a CSV file.

database.description: Connection name from the configured list.

source.description: Table name or SELECT statement to export.

path.description: Workspace path of the CSV file to create.

includeHeader.description: Write column names as the first row.

tools.name: import_csv
tools.snippet: Load the rows of a CSV file into a database table.

database.description: Connection name from the configured list.

path.description: Workspace path of the CSV file to read.

hasHeader.description: Treat the first row as column names.

onConflict.description: What to do when a primary key already exists.

tools.name: run_aggregation
tools.snippet: Compute a count, sum, or average over a table column with optional filters and grouping.

database.description: Connection name from the configured list.

column.description: Column to aggregate; ignored for count.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.snippet: Run the project's automated test suite, optionally limited to a path or name pattern.

path.description: Directory or file to limit the run to.

namePattern.description: Only run tests whose names match this pattern.

tools.name: format_code
tools.snippet: Rewrite source files to match the project's formatting rules.

configPath.description: Formatter configuration file to use instead of the default.

tools.name: lint_code
tools.snippet: Analyze source files for style and correctness problems without changing them.

fix.description: Apply safe automatic fixes for reported problems.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.snippet: Find where a function, class, or variable is defined or referenced in the codebase.

kind.description: Whether to return definitions, references, or both.

tools.name: apply_patch
tools.snippet: Apply a unified diff to files in the workspace.

dryRun.description: Check that the patch applies without writing.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.snippet: Open a new issue in the tracker with a title, description, and type.

title.description: Short summary of the problem or request.

description.description: Details, reproduction steps, or acceptance criteria.

tools.name: update_ticket_status
tools.snippet: Move an existing ticket to a new workflow status.

resolution.description: Required note when moving to resolved or closed.

tools.name: assign_ticket
tools.snippet: Set or change the person responsible for a ticket.

assignee.description: Username of the new owner; empty to unassign.

notify.description: Send the new owner a notification.

tools.name: comment_on_ticket
tools.snippet: Add a comment to an existing ticket.

internal.description: Hide the comment from external reporters.

tools.name: search_tickets
tools.snippet: Search issues in the tracker by text, status, assignee, or label.

query.description: Words to match in title or description.

assignee.description: Only tickets owned by this username.

labels.description: Only tickets carrying all of these labels.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.snippet: Send a short text message to a phone number.

to.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format.

message.description: Message text; longer texts are split into segments.

senderId.description: Registered sender name or number to send from.

tools.name: post_chat_message
tools.snippet: Post a message to a team chat channel or thread.

channel.description: Channel name such as #announcements, or a channel id.

threadId.description: Reply within this thread instead of posting a new message.

mentionHere.description: Notify everyone currently active in the channel.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.snippet: Schedule a personal reminder that notifies the user at a chosen time.

at.description: When to fire, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

tools.name: send_push_notification
tools.snippet: Send a push notification to the mobile app of one user, a segment, or everyone.

audience.description: A user id, a named segment such as beta_testers, or all.

deepLink.description: In-app route opened when the notification is tapped.

tools.name: schedule_digest
tools.snippet: Set up a recurring summary email of activity from selected sources.

cadence.description: How often the digest is sent.

sendHour.description: Local hour of day to send.
